content: SvelteKit 2 shared nav between admin and public layouts: best approach is a standalone Svelte component in src/lib/components/TopNav.svelte that accepts props for current user/admin context. Import it in both src/routes/+layout.svelte (public) and src/routes/admin/+layout.svelte (admin). Route groups with (public) and (admin) directory naming is an alternative but adds complexity not needed here since the layouts already exist. The component approach is cleaner — no new routing patterns, no new libraries, just extract the nav markup into a shared component.
